The post was made 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 4:05 PM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The phone's status bar shows LTE connectivity and a low battery icon. The main focus of the image is a close-up of a guitar, specifically a Fender Stratocaster-style electric guitar with a sunburst finish.
